name: Coca-Cola Consolidated - Indianapolis Production Facility, IN

fieldNotes.facility: Coca-Cola Consolidated Indianapolis manufacturing facility at 5000 W 25th St, operating since 1968. Four production lines (2 PET/rPET bottle, 2 can) plus a production warehouse; $35M glass-bottle line expansion announced May 2026. Roster lat/lng (geocode moved 1523m) landed on-target; the large white-roofed plant at the coordinates matches.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, gate, or guard booth. Street View (2024-07) of the main driveway off W 25th St shows a wide open entrance with a Coca-Cola entrance sign but no barrier or checkpoint. The driveway leads into the car parking lot and onward to the trailer yard.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the property line. A small canopy/structure sits inside the yard near the parking/yard boundary but is not a gate booth. Listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock-door rows on the north face and east face, each with multiple trailers backed in. Total estimated ~50; banded 50+ but could be 25-50 - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large herringbone trailer drop yard on the west side with well over 50 trailers/tankers parked.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on physically separate building faces (north face vs. east face), consistent with separate shipping/receiving.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep open paved yard between the entrance and the trailer yard / docks; ample stacking for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open driveway apron and extensive paved width at the entrance; room to add an express lane.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One large connected plant/warehouse with an attached south office wing (counted as 2); a small NE structure (possible scale/canopy) not counted as a full building.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within Indianapolis metro; bordered by dense residential subdivisions and near the Indianapolis Motor Speedway. Classified Urban.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in imagery.

citations.claim: Coca-Cola Consolidated to invest $35M in Indianapolis facility (5000 W 25th St), operating since 1968, adding a glass line

verification.rationale: Active Coca-Cola Consolidated manufacturing plant (5000 W 25th St); May 2026 PR announces a $35M expansion. Strongly current.
